title: GPOM Second Half B: Maddie at the Door
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half B: Maddie at the door
about: Cut 3 of the GPOM second half, split in two (Kai, round 2 Q5). Built by scripts/gpom/second-half-video/cut3.py B; notes and plan so far in ../second-half-cut2-notes.json, shots in ../second-half-cut3-shots.md.

beats.name: Maddie at the door
beats.blurb: Maddie rolls up to the shut bunker door and settles. No wrecks, no smoke.

beats.name: The tannoy
beats.blurb: Maddie's voice on the tannoy over Sandra and Derek mid-row (we never see the speaker). They stop dead. Cut to the crowd looking up.

beats.name: Hello
beats.blurb: Hard cut: the doors already open, Maddie rolls in. We do not see the humans properly yet.

beats.name: The old lady and Maddie
beats.blurb: The old lady among the crowd, the others in shadow; Maddie over her shoulder in the big doorway. Shot / reverse shot.
